digest.component_or_area: opcert signing provisioning and enforcement mechanism
propositions: The rebar-mcp container must be provisioned to sign op-certs (plan-review and completion-verifier) under the existing pinned environment 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65 by composing a signer binding from REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID and the materialized Ed25519 key, then verify that container-minted certs validate against the pinned public key while foreign-key certs are rejected.

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must jointly enforce post-boundary closes lacking valid completion-verifier certs (exit 1) while grandfathering pre-boundary closes (exit 0), proven against a fixture config with verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since set together, without modifying the authoritative rebar.toml.

The enforcement flip (move 2) must be deferred to a human-run operator runbook that documents the exact rebar.toml [verify] keys, preconditions that post-boundary closes route through the 9f1c8e42 signer first, expand-contract ordering, and rollback by unsetting require_environment.
Container signing provisioning (move 1) must be additive and reversible with no new environment or key created, no entry added to trusted_environments.yaml, and no private key committed.
Unsetting verify.require_environment must restore verify-opcert to advisory everywhere (exit 0), and existing opcert-minted certs must continue to verify as a regression control.
